sources.title: clef-flash - Cloudflare AI docs
sources.snippet: Clef-flash is a fast 9B multimodal decision model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question.
